description.value: Brickyard Pizza has been making fresh double-rise dough daily in Victoria since 1996, operating an open kitchen where all toppings are prepared in-house. The restaurant sources meat, produce, and beverages from local Victoria suppliers including Glenwood Meats, Island West, and Driftwood Brewery, prioritizing organic and hormone-free options where possible. Located beside the Odeon Theatre on Yates Street, it's a well-established neighbourhood pizzeria with a full bar, weekly specials, and event hosting capability.
